goal.zh: 把不同优化方法接入共享约束、候选来源、反馈与恢复流程。
goal.en: Connect optimization methods through shared constraints, candidate provenance, feedback and recovery.

constraints.zh: 平台组织这些方法，优化器主要覆盖序列梯度与局部扩散。前次工程检查未完成；本次未重新核对检查，不代表分子有效性得到证明。
constraints.en: The platform organizes these methods; the optimizer mainly covers sequence gradients and local diffusion. Earlier engineering checks were incomplete; checks were not rechecked here, and molecular effectiveness is not established.

label.zh: 序列梯度优化：借助模型反馈逐步调整序列表示，并遵守预先声明的约束。
label.en: Sequence-gradient optimization: adjust a sequence representation using model feedback within declared constraints.

label.zh: 局部扩散：在已有候选附近探索受约束的局部变化。
label.en: Local diffusion: explore constrained local changes around an existing candidate.

label.zh: 突变扫描：比较有界的单点或组合变化。
label.en: Mutation scanning: compare bounded single or combined changes.

label.zh: 骨架条件 MPNN：以给定骨架为条件生成序列候选。
label.en: Backbone-conditioned MPNN: generate candidate sequences conditioned on a backbone.

label.zh: MPNN 与 FastRelax：结合序列采样和结构松弛；计算评分需要独立评估。
label.en: MPNN plus FastRelax: combine sequence sampling and structural relaxation; computational scores need independent evaluation.
